faq_heading: Homes near Dorothy Peacock Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Dorothy Peacock Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Dorothy Peacock Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Dorothy Peacock Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Dorothy Peacock Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 84 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,350,000, townhomes $815,900, condos $512,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Dorothy Peacock Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Dorothy Peacock Elementary the median was 32 days on the market, closing at 97.1% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 84 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Dorothy Peacock Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Gordon Greenwood Elementary (0.6 km east), Walnut Grove Secondary (1.4 km east) and Yorkson Creek Middle School (1.6 km south-east).

Dorothy Peacock Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 20292 91a Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Dorothy Peacock Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Dorothy Peacock Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Dorothy Peacock Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Dorothy Peacock Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 84 homes sold within 1 km of Dorothy Peacock Elementary: 37 houses, 10 townhomes and 34 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,350,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Dorothy Peacock Elementary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Dorothy Peacock Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 2 secondary, 2 middle; 0 independent). The closest is Gordon Greenwood Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Richard Bulpitt Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Walnut Grove Secondary (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Walnut Grove Secondary (1.4 km). Other elementary schools close by: Gordon Greenwood Elementary (0.6 km east), Josette Dandurand Elementary (1.7 km south), West Langley Elementary (1.9 km north-east), James Kennedy Elementary (1.9 km east), Alex Hope Elementary (2.2 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Gordon Greenwood Elementary, 0.6 km east of Dorothy Peacock Elementary.
